title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust: We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health: We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect: We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability: We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity: We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Keeta- KA District Manager
description:

Implement Keeta's sales and operational strategies in a highly competitive and fast-changing entrepreneurial environment.

Job Requirements:

  • Over 5 years of experience in KA management, channel expansion, or chain/retail management, with a solid foundation in team management.
  • Strong business negotiation and market development abilities, able to accurately identify client and user needs, and maintain a highly proactive approach to challenges.
  • Capable of process and project management, able to drive multiple tasks and complex projects in parallel.
  • Strong stress tolerance, clear results orientation, high sense of responsibility, and good team spirit.
  • English proficiency for work (listening, speaking, reading, writing); Portuguese language skills are preferred.

  • Deep participation in Meituan/Keeta's global strategic expansion, direct exposure to international competition, and accumulation of real frontline practical experience.
  • Work in a multinational, multicultural environment, collaborating with colleagues from 26 countries, and experience a strong entrepreneurial atmosphere.

Candidates with food delivery industry experience, or those who have been deeply involved in key business milestone projects (such as breaking monopoly, conquering leading brands, or expanding into new markets), are preferred.

title: Sales Development Representative (SaaS | Contractor)
description:

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth thanks to the support of renowned investors which include Atinum Investment, Tiger Global, Transcend Capital and Gobi Partners. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our customer engagement platform, both small merchants and large enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.

As we expand into emerging markets, we seek adventurous, diverse, and passionate individuals to join us on this exciting journey. Join our team and grow your career with SleekFlow!

Junior to Associate Level

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Prior Experience in Saas/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Fluent in English & Portuguese; Professional proficiency in Spanish

Role

We are looking for an ambitious Growth Partnership Executive to join our dynamic sales team. In this role, you will build and manage prospect relationships to drive revenue for SleekFlow. A vital part of this opportunity is partnering with the Customer Success and Product team to ensure the quality and quantity of sales pipeline.

Responsibilities

  • Handle our sales conversion process for Small & Medium Businesses
  • Developing and managing relationships within our Commercial segment with customers in the LATAM region.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement while creating satisfied and reference-able customers
  • Research and build >40 "cold accounts" (i.e.: adding contacts, sending emails, cold calling) everyday
  • Support our inbound and outbound sales teams in closing enterprise clients
  • Qualify leads and nurture them through the initial stages of the buyer journeys
  • Handle inbound tickets
  • Document all interactions and findings with leads in our CRM, and create a seamless handoff process to Account Executives
  • Involve in our International Market Expansion
  • Work with our sales teams, customer support, partnership and training team in Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, UAE and oversee the market launch project
  • Ability to stay up to date in the SaaS landscape and demonstrate our platform value

Requirements

  • Minimum 1 years of outbound sales or sales development experience (selling over the phone, cold calling), preferably B2B at a software company
  • Profound academic background from top-notch universities
  • Extensive experience selling to customers in the LATAM region
  • Consistently over-achieved quota (top 5-10% of the company) in past positions
  • Fluency in English is a MUST
  • Previous Experience in a startup is preferred

Desired Skills

  • Strong and demonstrated written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Sales Methodology training preferred.
  • CRM (e.g. Hubspot) & marketing experience preferred
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment.
  • Strong customer references
  • Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.

SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior | Controladoria
description:
A helloo desenvolve e opera soluções de mídia digital out of home em diferentes ambientes, como elevadores residenciais, shopping centers e aeroportos. Sua atuação abrange mais de 16 mil elevadores em condomínios, mais de 100 shoppings no Brasil e 17 aeroportos sob concessão da Aena, incluindo o de Congonhas, em São Paulo, por meio de uma parceria com a empresa NEOOH.

A empresa atende tanto grandes anunciantes quanto pequenos e médios empreendedores, utilizando dados comportamentais obtidos em seus pontos de presença para segmentar campanhas com maior precisão. Além disso, a helloo mantém uma operação dedicada à criação de experiências interativas em elevadores e espaços comerciais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Consolidar, analisar e garantir a integridade das informações contábeis e gerenciais da companhia;
  • Realizar o processo de fechamento gerencial, análise de variações e elaboração de reports executivos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar dashboards em Power BI, assegurando confiabilidade, automação e profundidade analítica;
  • Acompanhar KPIs financeiros e operacionais, apontando riscos, oportunidades e recomendações;
  • Apoiar revisões contábeis, conciliações críticas, controles internos e aderência a políticas;
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos processos de controladoria, trazendo eficiência e governança;
  • Atuar diretamente no planejamento financeiro: orçamento anual, forecast, projeções de resultado e análises de performance;
  • Estruturar modelos financeiros e relatórios de apoio às áreas de negócio e diretoria.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Forte base técnica em Contabilidade (BRGAAP e noções de IFRS);
  • Experiência sólida em FP&A, com capacidade de estruturar análises, projeções e cenários;
  • Domínio na elaboração de reports gerenciais, dashboards e relatórios executivos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Power BI, modelagem de dados e integração com fontes diversas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com grandes bases de dados (Excel avançado, SQL desejável);
  • Raciocínio analítico apurado, visão crítica e habilidade para transformar informações em insights acionáveis.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de mídia, varejo ou negócios com alto volume de dados;
  • Vivência com ERP integrados;
  • Inglês intermediário.

title: Assistente de Importação e Exportação

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company's various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company's strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

Required Skills

  • A bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload

Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We're building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Senior Account Manager - Installed Base (IB) BIJ
description:
This role is responsible for managing the installed base of Business Inkjet Printers in Brazil. A key mission is to ensure the right balance of sell-in to channels while guaranteeing that sell-out performance aligns with the actual print volume of the total installed base. The position requires strong analytical and commercial skills to optimize portfolio performance, protect channel profitability, and support market growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform supplies sales in collaboration with the Channel Account Manager, ensuring commercial alignment and consistent execution across the channel.
  • Monitor sales performance, inventory levels, margins, and profitability across the supplies portfolio.
  • Analyze the installed base against our AMPV to determine true ink-consumption potential by machine type.
  • Evaluate attach rates by sales channel and support sell-in planning to ensure full alignment between purchasing, demand, and the installed base.
  • Develop and track promotional activities to drive sell-in and increase channel engagement.
  • Support marketing and communication initiatives that reinforce the use of original supplies, highlighting risks and impacts associated with non-original products.
  • Conduct price-positioning, elasticity, and competitiveness analyses for each category.
  • Map and track compatible (third-party) products, including pricing, market share, and trends, and support brand-protection actions in partnership with the legal team.
  • Contribute to planning (forecast cycles)
  • Perform market research, competitive intelligence, and trend analysis to guide strategic decisions.
  • Prepare executive-level reports, dashboards, and performance presentations for internal stakeholders.
  • Support HW commercial, logistics, products and marketing teams on portfolio, pricing, and channel-strategy matters.
  • Identify opportunities for inventory optimization, mix efficiency, and demand-forecast accuracy.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Marketing, Economics, or related field.
  • Experience in sales, marcomm, e-commerce, product management or product analysis-preferably within printing, technology, or consumer goods industries.
  • Advanced Excel skills; Power BI proficiency preferred; experience with ERP systems (SAP); SF.com.
  • Good English required.

Personal Competencies

  • Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.
  • Clear communication and effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Proactive mindset with technical curiosity and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Results-driven with solid business acumen.

title: Learning & Development Senior Manager
description:
Job Summary:

The L&D Senior Manager is responsible for applying employee training programs, conducting training needs analysis, and developing engaging learning content. This role ensures smooth training logistics, maintains training records, and supports the continuous improvement of L&D initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Training Program Application

  • Schedule, organize, and deliver training programs through lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, and blended formats.
  • Apply training logistics, including scheduling, venue bookings, facilitator coordination, and employee enrollment.
  • Maintain and update the Learning Management System (LMS) and training records.
  • Handle administrative duties such as tracking attendance, sending reminders, and managing training budgets.

2. New Employee Orientation Facilitation

  • Design, update, and facilitate engaging onboarding programs for new hires.
  • Collaborate with HR and department leaders to ensure a smooth transition for new employees.
  • Continuously improve trainings based on feedback and evolving company needs.

3. Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation

  • Conduct surveys, interviews, and performance assessments to identify skill gaps.
  • Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, quizzes, and KPIs (e.g., completion rates, performance improvement).
  • Adjust training programs based on data insights to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.

4. Content & Training Material Development

  • Create and update training manuals, guides, job aids, and digital resources for employee learning.
  • Develop interactive content (e-learning modules, videos, quizzes, presentations).
  • Ensure materials comply with company policies and industry standards.

5. Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Conduct engaging live and virtual training sessions for employees at all levels.
  • Use diverse training methods (role-playing, simulations, discussions) to maximize learning.
  • Provide post-training support to reinforce key concepts.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with department heads to align training with business goals.
  • Support ad-hoc Learning initiatives (leadership development, new employees training, etc.).
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning through newsletters, LMS updates, and recognition programs.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Organizational Development, Education, or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years in Learning, training application, or HR, including facilitation and content creation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Technical Skills (Preferred/Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with LMS platforms and e-learning tools and knowledge of MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel) and video training software.
  • Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management abilities, Engaging facilitator with excellent presentation and communication skills. Analytical mindset to assess training effectiveness and adapt programs.

***Work model: In-office 5x a week.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.

Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil

POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:

As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.

Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.

This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer's technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP's, support FRISS' implementation teams & other potential duties.

DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.

  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.

  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.

  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.

  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.

  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.

  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.

JOB SKILLS:

Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.

Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS' product value

Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.

Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.

  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS' value through storytelling

and analytical insights.

  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Deion - Melhoria e Inovação no Processo Produtivo | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Você deseja atuar na vanguarda da transformação do processo produtivo por meio de práticas Lean? Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem quer impulsionar a eficiência operacional, reduzir desperdícios e fortalecer uma cultura de melhoria contínua em um ambiente industrial real.

A DEION CENTRO DE DISTRIBUIÇÃO está estruturando um desafio com foco em Lean no processo produtivo, com objetivo de promover melhoria e inovação. Buscamos um bolsista com formação em nível de doutorado em Engenharia de Produção, Gestão de Processos ou áreas afins, com visão sistêmica, capacidade analítica e habilidade para transformar diagnóstico em execução no chão de fábrica.

Se você tem perfil propositivo, domínio técnico em Lean Manufacturing e interesse em gerar impacto direto nos resultados do processo produtivo, esta oportunidade é ideal para aplicar conhecimento avançado, conduzir melhorias estruturadas e deixar um legado de eficiência e inovação.

Formação Acadêmica:

Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Automação, Engenharia de Processos e afins

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Melhoria e Inovação no Processo Produtivo

Principais Atividades:

  • Analista de Processo Produtivo;
  • Mapeamento de processos;
  • Acompanhamento de indicadores de produção;
  • Organização da equipe

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Conhecimento em processo produtivo;
  • Planejamento e controle de produção;

  • Segurança do trabalho e análise de dados.

  • Conhecimento em incompatibilidade química

title: Analista de CRO - Pleno
description:
Analista de CRO - Pleno

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você será responsável por liderar iniciativas de otimização da taxa de conversão, atuando como elo estratégico entre dados, tecnologia e negócios. Sua missão é identificar oportunidades de melhoria nas jornadas digitais dos usuários, propor hipóteses fundamentadas em dados e executar testes que impulsionem resultados mensuráveis. Atuará como tradutor entre linguagem técnica e de negócios, facilitando o diálogo com diferentes áreas da empresa para garantir que as decisões sejam data-driven e alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Analisar dados quantitativos e qualitativos usando ferramentas como GA4, Power BI e VWO para identificar gargalos e oportunidades de conversão em diferentes plataformas (VTEX, aplicativos proprietários e diversas ferramentas);
  • Desenhar e implementar testes A/B e multivariados utilizando VWO, incluindo a configuração técnica da ferramenta, criação de variações e definição de audiências;
  • Trabalhar na implementação e gestão do GTM para garantir o correto rastreamento de eventos e conversões;
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios em Power BI para comunicar resultados e insights de forma clara às áreas de negócio;
  • Implementar a ferramenta VWO, configurando experimentos e personalizações baseadas em IA para diferentes segmentos de usuários;
  • Manter diálogo constante com stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em hipóteses testáveis e apresentando recomendações baseadas em evidências para otimização contínua das taxas de conversão.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência prática e comprovada com implementação e configuração da ferramenta VWO, incluindo setup de testes A/B, personalização de experiências e uso de recursos de IA para otimização;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Google Analytics 4 (GA4), com capacidade de configurar eventos, criar funis de conversão e extrair insights comportamentais dos usuários;
  • Domínio de Google Tag Manager (GTM) para implementação de tags, triggers e variáveis, garantindo rastreamento preciso de conversões e eventos;
  • Experiência prática na criação e análise de testes A/B e multivariados, incluindo formulação de hipóteses, definição de métricas de sucesso e interpretação estatística de resultados;
  • Proficiência em Power BI para criação de dashboards e visualizações que comuniquem insights de forma clara e acionável;
  • Experiência trabalhando com diferentes plataformas de e-commerce (especialmente VTEX) e capacidade de se adaptar rapidamente a novos sistemas e ferramentas;
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação com áreas de negócio, traduzindo dados técnicos em recomendações estratégicas compreensíveis e acionáveis;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados quantitativos e qualitativos, identificando padrões, tendências e oportunidades de otimização;
  • Autonomia para priorizar iniciativas de teste com base em impacto potencial e viabilidade de implementação;
  • Atenção meticulosa aos detalhes na configuração de testes e análise de dados para garantir a integridade e precisão dos resultados.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir certificação em Google Analytics 4 (GA4) ou Google Tag Manager.
  • Tiver experiência com outras ferramentas de otimização e personalização além do VWO (Optimizely, AB Tasty, Dynamic Yield).
  • Conhecer metodologias avançadas de CRO, incluindo psicologia do comportamento do consumidor, princípios de persuasão e gatilhos mentais aplicados a conversão.
  • Tiver experiência com análise de heatmaps, session recordings e ferramentas qualitativas de análise de comportamento.
  • Conhecer SQL para extração e manipulação de dados diretamente de bases para análises mais profundas.
  • Tiver vivência com personalização baseada em IA e machine learning para otimização de experiências do usuário.
  • Possuir formação em Marketing Digital, Estatística, Análise de Dados, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Demonstrar conhecimento em UX/UI design e como elementos visuais impactam a conversão e experiência do usuário.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

Curtiu a oportunidade?

  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.

  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.

  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Sales Manager to drive the growth of our energy storage solutions in the Brazilian market. Customer & Partner Relationship Management

Act as the primary point of contact for key accounts and resolve commercial or technical inquiries in coordination with support teams.

Regularly report on sales performance, pipeline status, and market feedback to management.

Participate in industry events and trade shows to promote Pytes and generate leads.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field.

5+ years of sales experience, with at least 3 years in solar PV, energy storage, or related industries in Brazil.

Proven success in developing and managing distribution channels and key accounts.

Strong understanding of the Brazilian energy market, including residential and commercial storage applications.

Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

Fluent in Portuguese and professional proficiency in English.

Willingness to travel within Brazil as required.

Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

Opportunity to grow with a leading global energy storage brand.

Dynamic and supportive international work environment.

Role with meaningful impact in advancing clean energy adoption in Brazil.

Our client is a leading global consulting firm that delivers transformation programs for companies worldwide. They develop internal tools and client-facing web applications using modern full-stack development and Generative AI, focusing on automation, smarter decision-making, and enhanced user experiences.

About the role

We're hiring Full-Stack Engineers (Python/React/GenAI) to join multiple production AI initiatives. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary consulting team to build scalable web applications and integrate GenAI capabilities into business workflows.

This role is a great fit for engineers who like owning features end-to-end, collaborating with stakeholders, and shipping in a fast-moving environment. It's also important to note: general full-stack experience alone isn't enough. You'll be expected to contribute both to new builds from scratch and to improving and expanding existing systems - including integrating GenAI features that will be used in production.

What success looks like:

  • Ship production-grade features end-to-end using Python (Django preferred) and React, including well-structured APIs and reliable deployments.
  • Deliver GenAI features in production (LLM interactions, workflow automation, data enrichment, RAG) with practical guardrails and evaluation.
  • Improve performance and maintainability by identifying bottlenecks, strengthening service boundaries, and contributing to CI/CD quality.
  • Collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional teams across multiple initiatives and geographies.
  • Communicate fluently in advanced English (written and spoken), since day-to-day collaboration and all project communication will be conducted in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Python (Django preferred; Flask/FastAPI acceptable).
  • Build responsive, maintainable front-end interfaces using React.
  • Integrate Generative AI capabilities into existing and new applications (e.g., LLM interactions, workflow automation, data enrichment, RAG).
  • Design and implement REST APIs that connect front-end, back-end, and AI services.
  • Assist in testing, debugging, and deployment using modern CI/CD practices.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Must have:

  • Experience of at least 4 years of experience in the domain.
  • Solid hands-on understanding of Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI or similar).
  • High level of front-end familiarity with React (production web apps).
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating GenAI solutions in production (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, LangChain, embeddings, vector DB, RAG).
  • Master the fundamentals of RESTful API/Service integration design.
  • Experience with databases: SQL and/or NoSQL.
  • Knowledge of cloud environments: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of MLOps workflows (model evaluation, monitoring, prompt/versioning, deployment patterns).
  • Experience in consulting or enterprise settings.

Important to note:

  • Location: Brazil-based candidates ONLY (São Paulo & Rio areas)
  • Work model: Remote, with expected onsite visits a few times per month.
  • Type: Contract, 40h/week.
  • Duration: 6-12 months initially, with long-term engagement.
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship.

Why consider this opportunity?

  • You'll get access to Toptal's global network, including opportunities with Fortune 500 and other enterprise clients.
  • You'll have flexibility to choose projects that match your goals — part-time or full-time, short-term or long-term (based on matching and availability).
  • There's a potential path to direct employment with the client later.
  • The client may provide a Windows laptop.

• Liderar projetos estratégicos de implementação, evolução e otimização de sistemas que suportam o CSC e Suprimentos Indiretos, incluindo: ERPs, sistemas fiscais, financeiros e de folha de pagamento, plataformas de chamados, automação e analytics.

Requisitos:

title: Human Resources Business Partner Senior Manager (HRBP)
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we're on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better."

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.

About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil.

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments, balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.

Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.

Interested in joining Keeta?

Check out our open positions! When applying, your information will be securely stored and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates.

title: Information Technology Procurement, Corp IT
description:
Corporate IT is the backbone of our business. Our team helps the company to develop a competitive advantage through defining our technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising technical solutions that help us achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. As a part of our team, you'll help deliver seamless IT experiences and support to our internal employees by providing responsive helpdesk service, stable networks and reliable IT systems.

As a procurement associate at Corporate IT, you will be responsible for IT products procurement to support various business units. You will serve as the primary interface and act as process owner responsible for managing suppliers and internal customers. In this position, you will play a key role in procuring high-quality and cost-efficient supplies for the organization. You will follow procurement procedures, maintain an updated list of inventory and incoming IT purchases and supplies.

Job Description:

  • Following and enforcing the company's procurement policies and procedures
  • Managing inventories and maintaining accurate purchase and pricing records.
  • Maintaining and updating supplier information such as qualifications, delivery times, product range.
  • Researching and evaluating prospective suppliers
  • To source, negotiate and establish purchases for IT goods and services
  • Work with IT technical team and HQ procurement team to propose good solutions from commercial perspective, ensure out-coming high quality products/supplies

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree of business administration, accounting or related field is preferred
  • Knowledge of commercial relationship build-up and procurement techniques/process
  • Experience in negotiations and networking
  • Strong analytical skill, accurate and precise attention to details
  • Ability to multitask, priorities, and manage time efficiently
  • Good resource of supplier solutions is added advantage
  • Work experience in IT Suppliers/IT industry is added advantage
  • Initiative, enthusiasm and willingness to learn in a fluid and fast-paced environment
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively at all levels and with HQ Procurement team

title: Closer - Inside Sales
description:
Sobre a Piece

Somos um grupo de marcas de infoproduto e tecnologia que já soma R$ 15 milhões/ano em receita no portfólio. Temos operação presencial em São José dos Campos e estamos acelerando para atingir R$ 60 milhões de receita em 2026.

Vemos a convergência dos dois dos mercados mais aquecidos do mundo — IA e Creator Economy. De um lado, o software oferece infraestrutura, tecnologia e receita recorrente, mas carece de distribuição e demanda capital. Do outro, creators/infoprodutores possuem audiência massiva, confiança e comunidades engajadas, geram muito caixa, porém com menor visão de longo prazo e pouco LTV. Nossa tese é unir o melhor desses dois mundos para construir um conglomerado global de empresas na intersecção de infoproduto e tecnologia. Acreditamos que os próximos gigantes da América Latina surgirão dessa convergência.

Nosso momento é de crescimento acelerado, e estamos construindo as bases financeiras que sustentarão esse crescimento. Nosso ambiente é dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a resultados. Valorizamos pessoas que aprendem rápido, questionam o status quo e transformam complexidade em clareza.

O Desafio / O que você fará

Estamos em busca de um Closer (Executivo de Vendas) para converter oportunidades em clientes reais da Piece Digital. Procuramos um profissional com alto poder de persuasão, mentalidade consultiva e foco total em resultados, capaz de conduzir negociações do diagnóstico ao fechamento.

O perfil ideal é de um profissional "faca na caveira", mas que sabe ouvir. Você não é apenas um vendedor, mas um especialista que entende as dores do cliente e apresenta a Piece Digital como a solução estratégica definitiva. Sua missão é pegar o bastão passado pelos SDRs e garantir que a taxa de conversão seja máxima.

O Closer terá autonomia para conduzir suas negociações, gerenciar seu próprio funil de vendas e terá impacto direto no faturamento e na escala da empresa. Você trabalhará com metas claras e um modelo de comissionamento agressivo para quem entrega alta performance.

O que você vai Fazer

  • Venda Consultiva: Realizar reuniões de diagnóstico e demonstração, focando em entender as necessidades do cliente e gerar valor imediato.
  • Gestão de Oportunidades: Gerenciar o funil de vendas (pipeline) de forma eficiente, garantindo que as propostas avancem pelas etapas de decisão.
  • Negociação e Fechamento: Liderar as etapas finais de negociação, contornando objeções complexas e estruturando propostas comerciais vencedoras.
  • Interface com SDRs: Dar feedback constante ao time de prospecção para refinar a qualidade dos leads que chegam para a mesa de fechamento.
  • Uso Estratégico de CRM: Manter o histórico de todas as interações atualizado, utilizando os dados para prever faturamento (forecast) e otimizar o tempo de fechamento.

Requisitos

  • Experiência como Closer em vendas B2B (preferencialmente serviços digitais ou tecnologia).
  • Domínio de metodologias de vendas complexas (como SPIN Selling, Challenger Sale ou GPCTBA).
  • Habilidade de comunicação, oratória e escrita para apresentações executivas.
  • Capacidade de lidar com ciclos de venda curtos e médios, mantendo a disciplina no follow-up.
  • Competências comportamentais: Resiliência, orientação por metas (target-driven), alto poder de influência e rapidez de raciocínio para negociações sob pressão.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência anterior em agências de marketing digital ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Experiência em vendas High Ticket.
  • Histórico de ter superado metas de forma consistente em experiências passadas.

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

"Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM).

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação."

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB).
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.

Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.

Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance

About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.

About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a "fix bugs and update plugins" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.

What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery

What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team

You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines

Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE

How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)

Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

Nossa missão é clara: Engenharia inovadora para um mundo melhor, contribuindo para soluções mais seguras, sustentáveis e eficientes para nossos clientes.

title: Compliance Professional - Consultor(a) (Analista Pleno - Power Automate)
description:

Responsável em atuar com foco em soluções digitais, apoiando a aplicação de políticas internas e regulatórias em processos de TI, Rede, Segurança e Negócio, traduzindo requisitos de Compliance em soluções práticas e operacionais, contribuindo para a gerenciamento e mitigação de riscos, a integridade dos sistemas e a geração de valor para o negócio.

• Garantir evolução e melhorias para solução de GRC implementada.

• Experiência em soluções de IA como Copilot premium e Studio, e soluções de Multi-agentes.

• Conhecimento em controles e requisitos de segurança da informação/Compliance.

• Graduação em Sistemas da Informação, TI ou áreas correlatas.

• Certificação em Riscos e Controles: CCSA (Certification in Control Self-Assessment), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control);• Certificação em Agile/Scrum (PSM, CSM) ou PMP com ênfase em metodologias ágeis;

• Certificação em produtos Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

With offices in Latin and North America and Europe, we are present in the industrial routines of the largest companies on the planet! Innovation is in our blood! Our team is leading the way by delivering features companies need to stay competitive. All of this is to improve efficiency and increase productivity for companies by simplifying the SAP asset management process. We deliver data reliability and cost reduction to our partners so that they are increasingly at the top of their game. Be part of our story and lead the digital transformation with us!

We are looking for Customer Success talent with a passion for working in a high growth environment. To help manage our rapid growth, Sigga Technologies is investing in a critical role in Customer Success Management responsible for a unique opportunity to craft our customer success strategies, build strong relationships with a global customer portfolio, and partner with cross-functional Sigga executives. Our ideal candidate is an accomplished problem solver, data driven, and ready to travel worldwide to ensure customer health and drive value to our customers and expansions for Sigga Technologies.

About Us

With offices in Latin and North America and Europe, we are present in the industrial routines of the largest companies on the planet! Innovation is in our blood! Our team is leading the way by delivering features companies need to stay competitive. All of this is to improve efficiency and increase productivity for companies by simplifying the SAP asset management process. We deliver data reliability and cost reduction to our partners so that they are increasingly at the top of their game. Be part of our story and lead the digital transformation with us!

We are looking for Customer Success talent with a passion for working in a high growth environment. To help manage our rapid growth, Sigga Technologies is investing in a critical role in Customer Success Management responsible for a unique opportunity to craft our customer success strategies, build strong relationships with a global customer portfolio, and partner with cross-functional Sigga executives. Our ideal candidate is an accomplished problem solver, data driven, and ready to travel worldwide to ensure customer health and drive value to our customers and expansions for Sigga Technologies.

Objectives for the role

  • Drive product adoption post-implementation, enabling expected ROI attainment for the customer.
  • Set, monitor and achieve measurable outcomes and KPIs set with the customer (success criteria) related to customer value realization and mutual success.
  • Become a trusted, strategic advisor for your customers, willing to dig deep and learn about the direction of their company, goals, and how Sigga can help them achieve them.
  • Be the internal voice of the customer and work cross-functionally within Sigga Technologies to escalate risks and present recommendations & solutions.

What you'll do

  • Trusted Advisor – Build great customer relationships and set customers up for success by:
  • Understanding goals, strategies, & initiatives and establishing Sigga Technologies as the best-in-class workflow
  • Build trusted relationships with users and leaders to help them achieve their personal and organizational goals
  • Recommending best practices based on understanding customer's business goals, success criteria for getting value
  • Maintain customer health by developing and executing customer success plans that reflect a holistic path for customers to achieve ROI
  • Outcomes and Risk Management:
  • Drive adoption of Sigga Technologies' products to enable customers to achieve business value and critical outcomes
  • Measure and monitor KPIs to draw insights and execute actions
  • Own customer lifecycle experience including renewal conversations and exceed cross-sell revenue retention goals
  • Partner with Account manager and share growth opportunities
  • Stay current on Sigga Technologies' products and services and develop use cases to drive customers to adopt best practice standards.
  • Proactively manage at-risk customers and develop success plans, prevent churn and reduce unnecessary escalations.
  • Expand CSPs to include additional outcomes as customer needs evolve
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop customer case studies
  • Build and document new CS processes and procedures including playbooks, process outlines, best practices, engagement strategies, etc.

What we're looking for

  • Enthusiasm for customer success and excellence, especially within the SaaS space
  • Willingness to learn, collaborative, growth mindset, goal oriented comfortable with ambiguity / changing priorities as part of the start-up culture
  • Proven record of delivering effortless customer experience, and customer-centric internal communications
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to support joint outcomes through customer lifecycles
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively via oral & written formats: PowerPoint and Excel skills are a must, especially with multiple stakeholders/personas
  • Demonstrated creation of data-driven customer action plan strategies

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent time management skills, managing work time responsibly and efficiently
  • Escalation and conflict management skills
  • Ability to be highly collaborative with internal and external teams
  • Independent, critical thinker/problem-resolution skills
  • High accountability to outcomes
  • 5+ years of experience in direct customer engagement roles
  • 3+ years of SAP PM and/or EAM/CMMS experience
  • Strong verbal and written English

Preferred Skills/Abilities

  • 5+ years of account management, customer success, or managed services
  • CRM experience, managing expansion opportunities and customer relationship mapping
  • 3+ years of SAP PM and/or EAM/CMMS experience
  • Microsoft Office/O365 experience

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree (B. A.) in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Other

  • Located in Brazil; Hybrid in Belo Horizonte office preferred
  • Willing to travel up to 25% (domestic and international)

title: Pré-Vendas Outbound (BDR) — B2B | Energia Solar | Belo Horizonte/MG

Seu objetivo no cargo:

Ser o primeiro contato com empresas do nosso perfil ideal (ICP), abrir portas com decisores e agendar reuniões qualificadas para o time de vendas (closers), garantindo qualidade e previsibilidade no funil.

O que você vai fazer (dia a dia):

  • Prospecção ativa (Outbound) em multicanais: telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e LinkedIn
  • Pesquisa e segmentação: mapear empresas, decisores e sinais de oportunidade
  • Abordagem consultiva e objetiva, com perguntas que qualificam e direcionam

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência prévia em pré-vendas/SDR/BDR ou rotina forte de prospecção (mín. 6 meses ajuda bastante)
  • Boa comunicação (oral e escrita) e segurança por telefone
  • Resiliência para lidar com "não", volume e repetição sem perder energia
  • Organização e rotina com CRM e métricas
  • Vontade real de aprender e evoluir (vendas consultivas + setor técnico)

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios):

  • SPIN / BANT / GPCT, Receita Previsível
  • Experiência em B2B, venda consultiva ou setor técnico (engenharia/energia)
  • Familiaridade com Bitrix24 (ou CRMs como HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce)

Perfil que dá certo aqui (Sunus)

  • Gente com fome de crescimento: pessoas que realmente estão a fim de dar um gás para mudar de vida
  • Disciplina de rotina e consistência (cadência, follow-up, CRM)
  • Curiosidade, energia e abertura para feedback/treinamento

Regime, local e horário

  • Contratação: CLT ou PJ
  • Modelo: Presencial (Belo Horizonte/MG)
  • Horário: seg a qui 07:30–17:30 | sex 07:30–16:30

Remuneração

  • Fixo + variável (comissão/bonificação por performance)
  • Faixa estimada: R$ 2.500 a R$ 4.000 (dependendo da experiência e do atingimento)

Benefícios

  • VA/VR: R$ 28/dia
  • VT ou auxílio combustível
  • Plano de saúde Unimed
  • Treinamento + trilha de crescimento (SDR → Closer / Coordenação)

title: Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Chavi Tecnologia - Desenvolvimento de Fechadura Inteligente
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Chavi é uma startup paranaense que desenvolve soluções de gerenciamento de acesso inteligente, substituindo chaves físicas por tecnologia: suas fechaduras e dispositivos digitais permitem abrir portas via smartphone, com controle seguro e remoto de acesso.

O hardware e o software são desenvolvidos internamente por uma equipe multidisciplinar de engenheiros eletrônicos, mecânicos e de computação — o que garante controle completo sobre o produto e independência tecnológica.

Projeto: Desenvolvimento de Fechadura Inteligente

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo Engenharia Mecatrônica, Engenharia Elétrica e Engenharia Eletrônica.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Principais Atividades:

  • Projetar placa (PCB) e esquema elétrico.
  • Selecionar microcontrolador e componentes.
  • Dimensionar alimentação e gerenciar consumo de energia.
  • Implementar circuitos de proteção e gerenciamento de bateria.
  • Integrar interfaces para módulos de comunicação (BLE, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT).
  • Desenvolver firmware para placa eletrônica.
  • Implementar sistema seguro de boot e atualizações OTA.
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento da estrutura física do produto.
  • Definir motor e materiais.
  • Contribuir para definição do processo de montagem e testes.
  • Implementar criptografia, armazenamento seguro e autenticação.
  • Preparar documentação e apoiar certificações.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica, guias e materiais de instalação.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Conhecimento em eletrônica e experiência em desenvolvimento de IoT.

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de produtos eletromecânicos de precisão.

Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho: Híbrido – Curitiba/PR

Soft Skills: Autogestão, Pensamento crítico, Criatividade e Organização.

Como cortesia a empresa oferece VT e VR.

title: Analista de compras sênior
description:

Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.

O que estamos buscando?

Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com .NET Core e Python. Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS (DataMesh, Lambda, RDS MySQL, DynamoDB, ECS Fargate, API Gateway, etc.). Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços e aplicações distribuídas. Conhecimento em SQL Server, MySQL e DynamoDB. Experiência com mensageria (Kafka). Prática com Docker e Kubernetes. Vivência com CI/CD (CodeCommit, CodePipeline, CodeBuild). Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e DevOps. Diferenciais: Experiência com Angular Microfront-End. Conhecimento em monitoramento e observabilidade em aplicações cloud. Desenvolver e manter aplicações .NET Core com integração em ambientes AWS. Criar e consumir REST APIs para integração entre sistemas. Implementar testes unitários para garantir qualidade e robustez do código. Trabalhar com Docker e Kubernetes para containerização e orquestração de serviços. Desenvolver e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Lambda (Python), ECS Fargate, API Gateway, EventBridge, RDS MySQL, DynamoDB, Elastic Cache Redis, Secrets Manager, KMS, entre outros serviços AWS. Implementar soluções escaláveis e resilientes utilizando mensageria (Kafka). Aplicar conceitos de CI/CD utilizando CodeCommit, CodePipeline, CodeBuild. Seguir boas práticas de desenvolvimento orientadas a DevOps, Lean e Metodologias Ágeis.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas;

  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

O que oferecemos:

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

title: OPERADOR DE TRATAMENTO DE EFLUENTES
description:
Fundada em 1899, a Sonoco é um fabricante líder de embalagens de consumo e industrial.

As nossas soluções de embalagem integradas ajudam a definir a personalidade das marcas, a criar experiências únicas para os clientes e a melhorar a qualidade dos produtos e a qualidade de vida das pessoas em todo o mundo.

Tudo isto ao serviço do nosso objetivo: Melhores Embalagens. Uma vida melhor.

A Sonoco está empenhada em criar produtos, serviços e programas sustentáveis para os nossos clientes, funcionários e comunidades.

Saiba mais em Sonoco.com

OPERADOR DE TRATAMENTO DE EFLUENTES

Descrição: Operar a estação de tratamento de efluentes industriais, por meio equipamentos disponíveis no tratamento físico-químico e biológico, a fim de atender à legislação ambiental.

Requisitos:

• Ensino médio completo;

• Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala 6x2 – Turno B

Responsabilidades do cargo:

- Operar e controlar a estação de tratamento de efluentes industriais, por meio de equipamentos;

- Controlar e acompanhar o desempenho dos equipamentos, registrando e corrigindo as irregularidades ocorridas durante o processo operacional, anotando em boletins e livros de ocorrência;

- Analisar o efluente antes, durante e depois do tratamento, determinando por meio de métodos analíticos, parâmetros de demanda química de oxigênio, sólidos sedimentados, nitrogênio, fósforo, pH, sólidos suspensos totais, oxigênio dissolvido e observações críticas de microorganismos em microscópio;

- Manter os equipamentos em boas condições de funcionamento, solicitando manutenção sempre que necessário;

- Controlar a dosagem de nutrientes na estação de lodos ativados;

- Controlar a dosagem de polímeros no tratamento primário;

- Realizar o correto manuseio de materiais e produtos da estação de tratamento, mantendo a qualidade do efluente final dentro dos limites permitidos por lei, evitando possÍveis danos ao meio ambiente.

A Sonoco valoriza a diversidade e está comprometida em oferecer oportunidades iguais a todas as pessoas, independentemente de raça, etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica pessoal.

title: Gerente de Warehouse
